material_response.basis: Every transported fuel-element nuclide, including fixed inert constituents.

effective_approximations.temperature_basis: Initial single-temperature homogenized element; other regions retain their declared material temperatures. This does not resolve separate fuel, clad and coolant temperatures inside the element.
effective_approximations.carbon_transport: Combine C12 and C13 number densities into evaluated natural carbon C0.
effective_approximations.oxygen_transport: ENDF/B-VII.1 has no O18 evaluation; assign its 0.20004 atom-percent oxygen abundance to O16, retaining total oxygen atom density. Track this declared data approximation.
effective_approximations.organic_thermal_scattering: Free-gas treatment; no evaluated HB-40 molecular scattering law is available in the selected library.

case.depletion_scope: Full evaluated chain for UO2 and its products. Homogenized cladding and organic coolant remain inert. Initial checks do not establish timestep or equilibrium convergence.

result.normalization: Specified fission power; source-normalized flux and reaction tallies

material_response.spectrum: Frozen at this native reference; updated after a new reference
material_response.reconstruction: Absolute isotope contraction, including fixed inert constituents.

result.analog_isotope_normalization: Native analog isotope scores include density; divide by density before microscopic contraction

physical_inventory_checks.scope: All fuel-region absorption, fission and scattering tables reconstruct from isotope densities. This checks data consistency, not Monte Carlo convergence.

depletion_response.scope: Physical microscopic group cross sections times flux. Every chain reaction of a present fuel-element nuclide uses direct scores; absent parents retain evaluated-data histogram collapse. Spectra are refreshed by OpenMC at each state and frozen locally during differentiation.
